line: Publish and run apps on Replit's managed cloud infrastructure.

free.text: Starter: 1 published app, monthly credits; link expires after 30 days

cells.regions: Free defaults US; paid regions list 5 areas (guide conflict)

work.math: $20 Core plan. Static sites and 100 GB of data sent out fit the 100 GiB allowance. Assumes normal builds and no other paid usage uses up the single $20 credit pool.
The VM costs $35 a month fixed, or 730 hours × $0.0486 an hour = $35.478. Core's $20 credit applies once, and 100 GB fits within 100 GiB. Tax is not included.

Subtotal is $155.30 or $155.778, plus $0.09 per backup unit and $0.05 per network unit (counts unknown). Assumes 10 GiB billed storage, 730 active database hours, and PITR off. Whether database RAM fits is unknown.
